reason: A 100g tube won't even last a single weekend trip for our family, and paying ₹99 every couple of days makes no sense when we already have our regular pantry sauces.
objection: 100g is far too small; that will finish in 4 or 5 parathas leaving an empty tube.
would_change_my_mind: A larger 350g to 500g family squeeze bottle priced competitively against mainstream sauce brands.
